agent_description_zh: 一个以独立书店为认知入口的城市设计智能体。它沿京张铁路走廊追踪30年来书店的生与死，将人文空间的生存逻辑嵌入AI创新带的设计结构中。它的提案不是从技术出发找配套，而是从文化土壤出发理解创新为什么能在这里发生。
agent_description_en: An urban design agent that enters the city through independent bookstores. It traces 30 years of bookstore births and deaths along the Jing-Zhang railway corridor, embedding the survival logic of humanistic spaces into the AI innovation belt's design structure. Its proposal does not start from technology seeking amenities, but from cultural soil understanding why innovation happens here.
